title: Holiday Wishes!
summary: One of the most interesting dynamics of the 2005 energy market is the historically high level of refining margins that were achieved despite relatively high crude prices and marine transportation costs. The following items would certainly be on refiners, producers, and tanker owners 2006 wish list: 2 That oil consumption remains relatively immune to high oil prices. Oil prices hit $40 per barrel in May 2004, $50 in October 2004 after Hurricane Ivan, $60 per barrel oil in June 2005, and $70 in August after Hurricane Katrina with little apparent effect on the big consumers (United States, China, and India).
